mūlasuddhi:
[Mūla+suddhi]  CL=7 The original purity or purified source:
when one says, "Buy a robe with this offering money and donate it to such-and-such a monk," this is called Āgamanasuddhi (purity of receipt), which equates to mūlasuddhi (purity at the root). Hence, it is suitable for the kappiyakāraka (layperson acting on behalf). However, if one merely says, 'Offer this money to the monk,' this does not count as Āgamanasuddhi = mūlasuddhi. Therefore, it is not suitable for the kappiyakāraka.

mūlayamaka: [Mūla+yamaka] (na) CL=7 Mūlayamaka or a pair of origins/roots.
mūlayamakānantaraṃ: [Mūlayamaka+anantaraṃ] (bya) CL=7 Goiing beyond Mūlayamaka. The back or other side of Mūlayamaka.
mūlayati: [Mūla+ṇaya+ti] (kri) CL=7 [Nīti, dhā, nhā. 342. Mūladhātu explains the meaning of Patiṭṭha, it is Bhūvādi. In this place, there is Curādi in Patiṭṭhāna].
mūlayoga: [Mūla+yoga] (pu) CL=7 Yoking with the origin or root. See - Mūlakanaya.
mūlayogadīpana: [Mūlayoga+dīpana] (ti) CL=7 Explain the state of yoking with the origin or root.
mūlayogasāmañña: [Mūlayoga+sāmañña] (na) CL=7 Sāmañña that is yoking with the origin or root.
mūlayogavisesa: [Mūlayoga+visesa] (pu) CL=7 The superior state of yoiking with the origin or root.
mūlayutta: [Mūla+yutta] (ti) CL=7 Yoked with the origin or root.
mūlaṭṭha: [Mūla+ṭhā+a] (ti) CL=7 One who is the first person or originator. Mūlaṭṭha(pu) [mūla+attha] The meaning of the origin or root. The basic cost or capital.
mūlaṭṭhakathā: [Mūla+aṭṭhakathā] (thī) CL=7 Mūlaṭṭhakathā. First commentary. See - Mahāaṭṭhakathā.
mūlaṭṭhakathāsāra: [Mūlaṭṭhakathā+sāra] (pu) CL=7 The essence of the first commentary.
mūlaṭṭhavācī: [Mūlaṭṭha+vācī] (ti) CL=7 Teaching the meaning of the origin or teaching the meaning of the originator.
mūlaṭṭhāna: [Mūla+ṭṭhāna] (na) CL=7 The place of an origin. Originator.
mūlekadesa: [Mūla+ekadesa] (pu) CL=7 One part of the origin.
mūlika: [Mūla+ika] (ti) CL=7 (1) Has the root cause or origin. (2) One who is selling the roots.
mūlosadha: [Mūla+osadha] () CL=7 Root medicine or the medicine that is from the root.
mūlupanissaya: [Mūla+upanissaya] (pu) CL=7 The decisive support that is the origin or the root.
mūluppattivacana: [Mūluppatti+vacana] (na) CL=7 Saying about the beginning arising.
mūlādāyaka: [Mūla+ādāyaka] (ti) CL=7 One who is taking the disputed matter. (In this place, that is for Āvāsika Bhikkhu. See the original Jātaka).
mūlāgantukabhavaṅga: [Mūlāgantuka+bhavaṅga] (na) CL=7 The original sub-cons consciousness and the newcomer sub-consciousness (Syha).
mūlākusalakamma: [Mūla+akusalakamma] (na) CL=7 Unwholesome Kamma that is the root cause.
mūlānubhāva: [Mūla+ānubhāva] (pu) CL=7 The power of the medicinal root.
mūlānumūla: [Mūla+anumhula] (na) CL=7 The base of the base. The root cause. (In Syha- translated the base of the root and the tip of the root).
mūlānupassī: [Mūla+anupassī] (ti) CL=7 One who repeatedly meditates on the root cause.
mūlānussati: [Mūla+anussati] (thī) CL=7 The recollection of the base or root. See - Mūladassana.
mūlāpattiṭṭhāna: [Mūlāpatti+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 The position or place of the beginning offense.
mūlāvasāna: [Mūla+avasāna] (na) CL=7 Mūlaava-sāna.(puda). (They are the same as Kusalapadakusalapadāva-sāna, etc., that is the so-called Mūlaavasāna-vasenasadisataṃ).
mūlāvayava: [Mūla+avayava] (pu) CL=7 A part of the root of the tree.
mūlāvāsa: [Mūla+āvāsa] (pu) CL=7 The old dwelling place or lodge.
mūlāvāsavināsa: [Mūlāvāsa+vināsa] (pu) CL=7 Destruction of the old residence or lodge.
mūlī: [Mūla+ī] (ti) CL=7 (1) Has the origin. (2) With the roots. (A tree) that is completed with roots.
mūlūpanissaya: [Mūla+upanissaya] (pu) CL=7 The decisive support that is an origin or the root.
mūsati: [Mūsa+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 [In Nīti,dhā.173. it is musati]. He steals.
mūsika: [Mūsa+ṇvu] (thī,pu) CL=7 [Dhāna, ṭī.618. InThī mūsikā] (1) Mice. (Ti) (2) (A slave) who is named Mūsikā.
mūsikaccheda: [Mūsika+cheda] (pu) CL=7 Cutting by a mouse. See - Mūsikacchinna.
mūsikacchinna: [Mūsika+chinna] (ti) CL=7 (A) Cut by a mouse. (B) A book that explains the matter of cutting by a mouse. (In Myanmar translation. (In Myanmar translation the gnawed by mice book).
mūsikakaṇṇa: [Mūsikā+kaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 One whose ears are like the mouse"s ears. One who has small ears.
mūsikapotaka: [Mūsika+potaka] (pu) CL=7 A little or small mouse.
mūsikasadda: [Mūsika+sadda] (pu) CL=7 The vocal sound of a mouse.
mūsikasobbha: [Mūsika+sobbha] (na) CL=7 A pit dug by mice.
mūsikavaṇṇa: [Mūsika+vaṇṇa] (pu) CL=7 The appearance of a mouse.
mūsikavijjā: [Mūsika+vijjā]  CL=9 The craft of healing the mouse-bite.
mūsikavisa: [Mūsika+visa] (pu,na) CL=7 [Dhāna.655.]  The poison of the mouse.
mūsikukkara: [Mūsika+ukkara] (pu,na) CL=7 The pieces of land that are dug by mice. Turned up the earth by the mice.
mūsikukkura: [Mūsika+ukkura] (pu,na) CL=7 The pieces of land that are dug by mice. Turned up the earth by the mice.
mūsikādarī: [Mūsikā+darī] (thī) CL=7 A pit that is dug by mice. A mouse hole.
mūsikūpama: [Mūsika+upamā] (ti) CL=7 Like a mouse. A simile of a mouse.
mūsā: [Mūsa+a+ā] (thī) CL=7 [Dhāna,ṭī.526.] Crucible (a ceramic or metal container in which metals or other substances may be melted or subjected to very high temperatures).
mūsāmukha: [Mūsā+mukha] (na) CL=7 The mouth of a crucible.
mūḷha: [Muha+ta] (ti) CL=7 [Amuyhītimūḷho. Rū,nhā.379. Mūha+la. Dhāna, ṭī.721.] One who is being unconscious or one who is a foolish person.
mūḷhacitta: [Mūḷha+citta] (na) CL=7 (1) Unconscious mind. (Ti) (2) One who has an unconscious mind.
mūḷhadhamma: [Mūḷha+dhamma] (pu) CL=7 The nature of an unconscious person. See - Anariyadhamma.
mūḷhadhātuka: [Mūḷha+dhātu+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who is unconscious and has weak wisdom.
mūḷhagabbha: [Mūḷha+gabbha] (pu) CL=7 (1) Pregnancy that can make the mother dizzy and tired. (2) The pregnant mother who is dizzy and tired due to having a difficult birth. (Thi) (3) The pregnant mother whose conception states (baby) is in an abnormal position in the womb of his mother. A pregnant woman whose baby is in a cross position in her womb.
mūḷhagabbhabhāva: [Mūḷhagabbha+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 One"s pregnancy is a state of having a difficult birth.
mūḷhagabbhabhāvappatti: [Mūḷhagabbhabhāva+patti] (thī) CL=7 The pregnancy that reaches a state of having a difficult birth.
mūḷhagabbhadukkha: [Mūḷhagabbha+dukkha] (na) CL=7 The suffering or pain that is due to having a difficult birth.
mūḷhapuggala: [Mūḷha+puggala] (pu) CL=7 A foolish person. See - Dattupaññatta.
mūḷharūpa: [Mūḷha+rūpa] (ti) CL=7 One who is foolish or stupid.
mūḷālakuṇḍalaka: [Mūḷāla+kuṇḍalaka] (na) CL=7 The base of the lotus. Lotus earrings. See - Mūḷālivattaka.
mūḷālivattaka: [Mūḷāli+vattaka] (na) CL=7 The base of the lotus. Lotus earrings.
mūlavīmasaka: [Mūla+vīmaṃsaka] (pu) CL=7 One who investigates the origin or root.
mūlayamakānantara: [Mūlayamaka+anantaraṃ] (bya) CL=7 Goiing beyond Mūlayamaka. The back or other side of Mūlayamaka.
